description: [Alexandria] GTFS for Public Transport is a data set listed in Transport Data Commons (Transport Data Catalogue), a transport data catalogue, published or maintained by Transport for Cairo. This General Transit Feed Specification (GTFS) dataset represents the Alexandria road transport network, covering both popular transport and formal bus routes. Developed by Transport for Cairo (TfC) through fieldwork conducted in 2022, it includes geographic tracing of routes, systematic recording of boarding and alighting locations with passenger counts, and measurement of service frequency at terminals. Coverage: Egypt. The portal files it under the publisher Transport for Cairo. Its tags are Alexandria, Egypt, GTFS. It offers 1 resource(s) in ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-tdc-portal.
